execute: Recover the narrow claim, original observations, tested conditions, observer and normal controls. Separate a valid refutation from an invalid observer or missing input. Record identity, object, input shape, deployment, credential generation and business result; missing dimensions stay unknown. For corrections link contrary evidence and controls, preserve historical observations, and identify only dependent claims. Different reports of one event are one source; independent captures in one file remain distinct. Obtain the evidence needed for a conditional closure or changed-condition retest.
review: Close a claim only after a valid discriminating refutation under recorded conditions; failed baselines, missing inputs, 404s and absent success are not broad safety. Preserve closure reason, scope, evidence and concrete reopening conditions. Correct dependent impact/chain/summary claims together. Reopen affected branches for changed inputs, relationships, deployment, credentials, consumers or evidence; a new narrative alone is not a new experiment.
